description: A valid en catalog plus one file of each rejected class: 'catalog.json' (throws during discovery), '.de' (hidden), and 'notes.txt' (unrecognised, skipped in silence). Each is then also named as an EXPLICIT classpath resource, where the filename rules do not apply at all — same bytes, same package, different outcomes depending on the entry point. Also the host fixture for the three loadFromClasspathResources path-validation cases, which need only a classloader root.
